rows.msgid:
OrcaSlicer 2.5.0 restructured many system filament presets to fix incorrect profiles and prepare for future features. As a result, the presets below no longer show on some printers they were made for. Sorry for the trouble; this is a one-time fix.

Add those printers back to your presets now? Your presets are backed up first. You can also do this later from Help > Migrate Filament Presets.
rows.reason: kept-name: refers to an OrcaSlicer release

rows.msgid: Today, OrcaSlicer is the most widely used and actively developed open-source slicer in the 3D printing community. Many of its innovations have been adopted by other slicers, making it a driving force for the entire industry.
